## Summary

Describe the focused change and the engineering problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] `npm run audit`

## Privacy and data safety

- [ ] Imported data and file metadata remain in the browser.
- [ ] No imported value is inserted with `innerHTML`.
- [ ] Samples and fixtures are entirely synthetic.
- [ ] No secret, private URL, customer identifier, local path, or proprietary documentation is included.

## Visual review

Describe desktop, mobile, keyboard, and full-bandwidth checks when the interface changes.
